players.name: Ja'Marr Chase
players.blurb: The Bengals star made the Madden 27 99 Club alongside Jaxon Smith-Njigba and entered training camp (starting July 28) with a determined message about staying dedicated after posting workout videos from Miami.

players.name: Josh Allen
players.blurb: Buffalo's training camp runs through August 7 with new coaching staff, putting significant pressure on the nine-year veteran quarterback to lead the team through a transitional period.

players.name: Jahmyr Gibbs
players.blurb: Detroit's fourth-year back is now the Lions' newly minted top option after splitting carries for three seasons, working alongside Jared Goff and Jameson Williams in a high-powered offense.

players.name: Bijan Robinson
players.blurb: The Falcons RB trained with Christian McCaffrey during the offseason and remains ranked among the elite running backs heading into the 2026 season.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.blurb: The Seahawks' 2025 AP Offensive Player of the Year posted 1,793 receiving yards and made the Madden 99 Club alongside Ja'Marr Chase, establishing himself among the elite WRs.

players.name: Drake Maye
players.blurb: A.J. Brown emerges as the WR1 with Drake Maye in New England, climbing into Round 2 territory after limited snap counts held back his predecessor.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.blurb: The Rams WR is participating fully in training camp and remains their top extension priority, though off-field legal issues under the NFL's Personal Conduct Policy may delay contract negotiations.

players.name: Lamar Jackson
players.blurb: Baltimore's QB has an ongoing contract extension situation while adapting to new OC Declan Doyle's scheme featuring more under-center looks; the Ravens restructured his deal to create $40 million in cap space.

players.name: Jayden Daniels
players.blurb: The Commanders' QB faces a significant adjustment under new OC David Blough with more under-center, play-action passing after operating primarily from shotgun previously.

players.name: Amon-Ra St. Brown
players.blurb: The Lions WR is part of Detroit's explosive offensive core returning alongside QB Jared Goff, RB Jahmyr Gibbs, and WR Jameson Williams for the 2026 season.

players.name: Joe Burrow
players.blurb: The Bengals QB is fully cleared for training camp and said he's part of the most talented team he's been on since being drafted in 2020, with newly improved defense complementing him.

players.name: Justin Jefferson
players.blurb: The Vikings star was given training camp off to manage a minor hamstring injury, similar to last year; the five-time 1,000-yard receiver caught 84 passes for 1,048 yards in 2025.

players.name: Caleb Williams
players.blurb: The Bears' third-year QB is navigating new offensive line personnel (new center and left tackle following Drew Dalman's retirement) while focusing on improved accuracy and continuing his progress as an in-rhythm passer.

players.name: CeeDee Lamb
players.blurb: The Cowboys star WR is holding out of training camp seeking a contract extension after finishing his rookie deal's final year.

players.name: Christian McCaffrey
players.blurb: The 49ers' 2025 Comeback Player of the Year posted 2,126 scrimmage yards and 17 TDs last season and is handling a large workload during training camp as he aims to build on his historic year.

players.name: Jonathan Taylor
players.blurb: The Colts RB led the NFL with 323 carries in 2025 and is entering the final year of his contract while seeking an extension; the team is aiming to take some workload off him in 2026.

players.name: James Cook III
players.blurb: The Bills RB won the 2025 rushing title ahead of Jonathan Taylor, Derrick Henry, and Bijan Robinson, looking to repeat under new coach Joe Brady.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.blurb: The Raiders' first-year RB posted just 975 rushing yards on a 3.7-yard average in 2025 and is ranked as a Round 2 fantasy pick as he seeks improvement in year two.

players.name: Malik Nabers
players.blurb: Nabers was not placed on the PUP list to start training camp, indicating he could be ready for Week 1 against the Cowboys.

players.name: Jeremiyah Love
players.blurb: The Cardinals' third-overall draft pick brings elite college production (362 carries for 2,497 yards, 35 TDs over two seasons) and should deliver immediate fantasy impact in his NFL debut.

players.name: Justin Herbert
players.blurb: The Chargers QB posted 3,727 passing yards and 26 touchdowns in 2025 while playing the final month with a fractured left hand; he is at camp for 2026 training.

players.name: Chase Brown
players.blurb: The Bengals RB rushed for 1,019 yards in 2025 with 69 catches (a Bengals record) and is in contract negotiations; he reported to camp but did not participate in practices.

players.name: Drake London
players.blurb: The Falcons extended London to make him one of the league's highest-paid pass catchers, and he's been shining in practice with five catches on five targets during an indoor session.

players.name: De'Von Achane
players.blurb: The Dolphins RB has been cleared for training camp with no restrictions after undergoing clean-up shoulder surgery in the offseason, following a 1,838-yard scrimmage year in 2025.

players.name: Patrick Mahomes II
players.blurb: The Chiefs QB received full practice clearance after suffering a torn ACL and LCL in December, though his participation level and preseason involvement remain under evaluation heading into camp.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.blurb: Bowers delivered a terrific rookie fantasy campaign and is ranked as the TE1 by analysts, representing one of only two key fantasy players on the Raiders.

players.name: A.J. Brown
players.blurb: The traded-to-Patriots WR has struggled early in training camp (one target, zero catches on Day 1; erased by CB Christian Gonzalez on Day 2) due to a lingering knee issue affecting his explosiveness.

players.name: Jalen Hurts
players.blurb: The Eagles QB threw a career-high 25 touchdowns in 2025 and is the Super Bowl LIX MVP, now adapting to OC Sean Mannion's Shanahan-style scheme featuring more under-center looks.

players.name: Omarion Hampton
players.blurb: The Chargers' injury-plagued rookie is expected to breakout in 2026 under new OC Mike McDaniel (whose Miami offenses averaged 4.6 yards per carry) with upgraded offensive line additions.

players.name: Trevor Lawrence
players.blurb: Lawrence reports to camp July 25 with first practice July 29, and the Coen hire looks like it could be career-changing for the franchise quarterback.

players.name: Kenneth Walker III
players.blurb: Walker signed a three-year, $43 million deal with the Chiefs and will be their clear feature back with top-12 fantasy RB upside, though injury history remains a concern.

players.name: Tetairoa McMillan
players.blurb: McMillan is expected to see significantly increased slot usage in his sophomore season with plans to 'launch him to stardom' per NFL Network, featuring more opportunities after the catch.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.blurb: Collins is ranked as a top-tier WR prospect with potential to vault to Tier 1 if healthy, though he has missed time due to injury in all five of his NFL seasons.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.blurb: Olave is expected to participate in Saints training camp while contract extension talks continue, avoiding a potential hold-in.

players.name: Saquon Barkley
players.blurb: Barkley regressed to RB14 in 2025 after his monster 2024 season, but is projected for top-15 running back status with possible top 5-7 upside if the Eagles' offense stays healthy.

players.name: George Pickens
players.blurb: Pickens has shown capability in one of the league's better offenses and looks to continue his success as he secures a long-term deal.

players.name: Derrick Henry
players.blurb: At age 32, Henry remains an RB1 with the Ravens despite declining efficiency metrics, but is no longer in the elite fantasy conversation.

players.name: Trey McBride
players.blurb: McBride posted 126 catches for 11 touchdowns with a 27.4% target share last season and is considered the best tight end in football.

players.name: Emeka Egbuka
players.blurb: The Buccaneers WR showed hot-and-cold form in 2025, averaging 89 yards per game with five TDs over his first five games before regressing to 41 yards per game with just one TD the remainder of the season.

players.name: Jaxson Dart
players.blurb: Dart delivered eight top-10 fantasy weeks despite playing only 12 games and has emerged as an elite rushing threat with improved coaching under John Harbaugh.

players.name: Bo Nix
players.blurb: Nix finished QB7 last season and is expected to be 'full go' in training camp after surgically repairing his right ankle, with Jaylen Waddle's addition expected to boost his 2026 value.

players.name: Rashee Rice
players.blurb: Rice has been cleared for the start of training camp after a minor clean-up procedure on his right knee in May.

players.name: Brock Purdy
players.blurb: Purdy has finished among the top-10 QBs in fantasy points per game for three consecutive seasons, including a fifth-place finish in 2025 despite missing eight games.

players.name: DeVonta Smith
players.blurb: With A.J. Brown sent to New England, Smith is getting a chance to be a WR1 and projects within a half point of 15 PPR FPPG for the Eagles.

players.name: Javonte Williams
players.blurb: The Cowboys RB is running away with the starting role, posting career-high 1,201 rushing yards across 16 games in 2025 as Dallas' lead back.

players.name: Garrett Wilson
players.blurb: Wilson is a prime bounce-back candidate after missing 10 games last season due to knee ailments, though he was performing like a top-10 fantasy WR through the first six weeks before his injury.

players.name: Dak Prescott
players.blurb: Prescott arrives at Cowboys training camp healthy with Super Bowl expectations, leading Dallas' loaded offensive arsenal and embracing the 'Super Bowl or bust' mentality as the team aims for a playoff return after missing out for two seasons.

players.name: Breece Hall
players.blurb: Hall signed a new deal to stay with the Jets and is being selected as RB15 in recent mocks, with Braelon Allen and Isaiah Davis competing for the backup role.

players.name: Carnell Tate
players.blurb: The Titans' No. 4 overall pick should be heavily targeted by Cam Ward and deliver immediate fantasy production as the team's top receiver.

players.name: Zay Flowers
players.blurb: Ravens coach John Harbaugh says Flowers 'can do everything' and looks forward to getting him the ball in as many ways as possible heading into 2026.

players.name: Ladd McConkey
players.blurb: McConkey will be 'full go' for Chargers training camp after recovering from a strained left hamstring during spring practices and is expected to be featured in offensive coordinator Mike McDaniel's speed-based offense.

players.name: Jordan Love
players.blurb: Love ranked QB19 in fantasy points per game (16.1 FPPG) despite strong efficiency stats and is best regarded as a high-end to midrange QB2 for 2026.

players.name: Luther Burden III
players.blurb: The Bears rookie WR was almost impossible to cover when he returned to practice in mid-July after missing most of the offseason with a soft-tissue injury, turning heads at training camp.

players.name: Kyren Williams
players.blurb: The Rams RB is among the team's key offensive contributors, scoring a touchdown in the 2026 NFC Championship Game for the defending Super Bowl contenders.

players.name: Jaylen Waddle
players.blurb: Acquired by Denver in a blockbuster trade from Miami, the dynamic WR is building chemistry with QB Bo Nix and appears to be living up to the hype after taking his first reps in mandatory minicamp.

players.name: Tee Higgins
players.blurb: The Bengals WR dealt with injuries in 2025 including hamstring and high ankle sprain, but played in 12 of 14 games and remains a key part of Cincinnati's elite receiving unit with Ja'Marr Chase.

players.name: Colston Loveland
players.blurb: The Bears rookie TE recovered from offseason shoulder surgery and burst onto the scene with 58 catches for 713 yards and 6 TDs, becoming the first rookie TE to lead the Bears in receiving yards since Mike Ditka in 1961, and will attend Tight End University this summer alongside Travis Kelce and George Kittle.

players.name: Jordyn Tyson
players.blurb: The Saints' 8th overall pick enters his first NFL training camp as a rookie WR after limited offseason work due to maintenance related to his injury history, with coaches eager to unleash the receiver who caught 61 passes for 711 yards and 8 TDs at Arizona State.

players.name: Makai Lemon
players.blurb: The Eagles' 20th overall pick is fully recovered from a hamstring injury and feeling '100%' for training camp, expecting to compete for the starting slot role alongside DeVonta Smith and Puka Nacua in Mike McDaniel's offense.

players.name: Jared Goff
players.blurb: The Lions QB enters his sixth season in Detroit and is adjusting to his fourth offensive coordinator in that span after a strong 2025 campaign (4,564 yards, 34 TDs, 8 INTs), seeking to recapture the grit of back-to-back NFC North-winning seasons.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.blurb: The RB departed Jacksonville in free agency and signed a multi-year contract with the New Orleans Saints to begin his tenure with a new team.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.blurb: Josh Jacobs has tumbled in drafts amid off-field concerns despite consecutive top-10 fantasy seasons with Green Bay, though he scored 31 touchdowns in 34 games with the Packers.

players.name: Terry McLaurin
players.blurb: The two-time Pro Bowler returned to Commanders training camp as a leadership presence and 'push our room, lead by example' after Washington's 5-12 season, with rookie Antonio Williams emerging as the No. 2 option.

players.name: Rome Odunze
players.blurb: Healthy heading into camp but carries a foot callous history; the stronger option between him and Luther Burden III after DJ Moore's departure to Buffalo.

players.name: DJ Moore
players.blurb: Acquired by Buffalo Bills for a 2026 second-round pick; reunited with former Panthers OC Joe Brady and positioned as potential WR1 for Josh Allen.

players.name: Mike Evans
players.blurb: Joined the 49ers in free agency after 12 seasons with Tampa Bay, marking the end of an era for the Buccaneers.

players.name: TreVeyon Henderson
players.blurb: The Patriots RB enters his second season feeling more comfortable after leading New England in touches (215), scrimmage yards (1,132), and total TDs (10) as a rookie, locked in as part of the one-two punch with Rhamondre Stevenson.

players.name: Tucker Kraft
players.blurb: Starting camp on PUP list following ACL surgery but is ahead of schedule and targeting a Week 1 return for Green Bay.

players.name: Davante Adams
players.blurb: The Rams WR led the NFL in receiving touchdowns in 2025 and is part of Matthew Stafford's elite receiving corps as Los Angeles aims to validate offseason hype.

players.name: David Montgomery
players.blurb: The Texans RB is a three-down back who 'can do it all' and will split lead back reps with Woody Marks in coach Danny Barrett's offense.

players.name: Christian Watson
players.blurb: The Packers WR stayed healthy in 2025 after returning from a torn ACL and posted the most consistent production of his career with 35 catches for 611 yards and 6 TDs, entering 2026 with no reported injuries.

players.name: Quinshon Judkins
players.blurb: The Browns RB is a 'full-go' for training camp and fully healthy after recovering from a fractured fibula and dislocated ankle suffered in Week 16, expecting to serve as the team's lead back and offensive leader.

players.name: Fernando Mendoza
players.blurb: No. 1 overall pick signed rookie contract with Las Vegas; Kirk Cousins set to open as starter with Mendoza learning behind him.

players.name: Jameson Williams
players.blurb: The Lions WR had a strong spring and enters training camp as a player to watch for a potential huge 2026 season alongside fellow WR Amon-Ra St. Brown.

players.name: D'Andre Swift
players.blurb: The Bears RB posted career highs in 2025 with 1,087 rushing yards and 9 TDs on 223 carries, forming one of the NFL's elite RB duos with Kyle Monangai and offering more explosiveness and pass-catching ability.

players.name: Bucky Irving
players.blurb: The Buccaneers RB expects to be a full participant for training camp and is ready for his full workload after recovering from shoulder surgery during the offseason.

players.name: Cam Skattebo
players.blurb: The Giants RB is ready to go for training camp after recovering from a catastrophic ankle injury suffered in his rookie season, though league sources have questioned his durability.

players.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
players.blurb: The Cardinals WR entered his third season after a disappointing 2025 (41 catches, 608 yards, 4 TDs across 12 games due to appendicitis and foot injuries), pulling himself from practice twice during camp with ankle concerns and drawing criticism for a dropped pass.

players.name: Baker Mayfield
players.blurb: Made 'no real progress' on contract extension talks entering camp with the Buccaneers.

players.name: Brian Thomas Jr.
players.blurb: Third-year Jaguars receiver who struggled in 2025 after Pro Bowl rookie season; healthy and motivated this offseason with strong chemistry with Trevor Lawrence.

players.name: Cam Ward
players.blurb: Tennessee Titans' 2025 No. 1 overall pick entering second season after rocky rookie year; working with new OC Brian Daboll.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.blurb: Fully cleared for training camp after undergoing back microdiscectomy; expected to return as Detroit's top tight end with no limitations.

players.name: Kyle Pitts Sr.
players.blurb: The Falcons TE was not participating in on-field activities during OTAs due to a foot/toe injury. Pitts signed his franchise tender worth $15.045 million for the 2026 season.

players.name: C.J. Stroud
players.blurb: Stroud threw for a career-low 3,041 yards and 19 TDs in 2025 and should be targeted as a QB2 with upside after the Texans upgraded their running game with David Montgomery.

players.name: Parker Washington
players.blurb: The Jacksonville WR had a breakout 2025 season with 58 catches for 847 yards and five touchdowns despite spending half the year as a backup. Washington is a contract extension candidate entering 2026 as one of the Jaguars' most important offensive weapons.

players.name: Kyler Murray
players.blurb: Will split reps between first and second-team offenses alongside J.J. McCarthy for the Minnesota Vikings during camp.

players.name: Alec Pierce
players.blurb: Roughly a week away from practicing due to ankle injury as Indianapolis's No. 1 receiver option.

players.name: Jaylen Warren
players.blurb: Competing with veteran Rico Dowdle at running back for Steelers; slimmed down this offseason under new HC Mike McCarthy.

players.name: DK Metcalf
players.blurb: Will see increased formation movement for the Pittsburgh Steelers under new offensive scheme.

players.name: Kenyon Sadiq
players.blurb: The Jets' first-round TE rookie (16th overall) underwent minor hernia surgery this offseason but is expected to be ready for training camp. Sadiq posted a 4.39 forty-time at the Combine, the fastest ever recorded at the tight end position.

players.name: Chris Godwin Jr.
players.blurb: The 30-year-old Buccaneers WR has no lingering injury concerns and was a standout during OTAs, getting significant slot reps. Godwin could rebound into fantasy relevance in 2026 with added opportunities in Tampa's passing game following Mike Evans' departure.

players.name: Jordan Addison
players.blurb: The Vikings WR has been training with new QB Kyler Murray for two months in Dallas and reported early to Minnesota with Murray ahead of camp. Addison is identified as a player who must deliver a standout campaign for both his team and personal future.

players.name: Malik Willis
players.blurb: Signed by Miami Dolphins as projected starter; no longer with Tennessee Titans after being traded to Green Bay in 2024.

players.name: Sam Darnold
players.blurb: Led Seattle Seahawks to Super Bowl title in 2025 after Vikings released him; not participating in Minnesota's 2026 camp.

players.name: Rhamondre Stevenson
players.blurb: Left New England practice early with undisclosed issue during opening week of camp.

players.name: Courtland Sutton
players.blurb: Signed four-year, $92 million extension with Broncos; transitioning from unquestioned WR1 to supporting role alongside newly acquired Jaylen Waddle.

players.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
players.blurb: Traded to Pittsburgh Steelers from Indianapolis; reunited with Aaron Rodgers under new Steelers offense.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.blurb: Brooks is in his first NFL training camp following multiple torn ACLs but is believed healthy and generating early 'hype train' momentum as he competes for the lead back role in Carolina.

players.name: Tony Pollard
players.blurb: Running back with Tennessee Titans entering 2026 season.

players.name: Josh Downs
players.blurb: The Colts WR is expected to take on a significantly larger role this season following Michael Pittman Jr.'s departure. Downs has no lingering health concerns and the Colts believe he can succeed in an expanded offensive role.

players.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
players.blurb: Robinson signed with the Tennessee Titans in March 2026, not the New York Giants, reuniting with offensive coordinator Brian Daboll on a four-year, $70 million deal with $38 million guaranteed. He will enter Titans training camp with increased offensive responsibilities.

players.name: Isaiah Likely
players.blurb: The New York Giants signed Likely to a three-year, $40 million deal in free agency, and he has already demonstrated strong connection with new quarterback Jaxson Dart in early workouts.

players.name: Quentin Johnston
players.blurb: The Chargers WR had a career-best season in 2025 with 51 catches for 735 yards and eight touchdowns after the team picked up his fifth-year, $18 million option. Johnston is working to establish himself as a consistent outside threat in Mike McDaniel's offense.

players.name: Rico Dowdle
players.blurb: Dowdle signed a two-year, $12.25 million deal with the Pittsburgh Steelers as an unrestricted free agent after one season in Carolina. He reunites with Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy, who coached him in Dallas from 2020-2024.

players.name: Michael Wilson
players.blurb: The Cardinals WR reached the 1,000-yard mark for the first time in 2025 with 78 catches for 1,006 yards and seven touchdowns, playing in every game for the first time. Wilson is looking like a potential WR1 in Mike LaFleur's offense heading into 2026.

players.name: Matthew Stafford
players.blurb: The reigning NFL MVP looked sharp in his first 2026 training camp practice for the Rams after a scheduled day off. LA is carefully managing his workload during camp.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.blurb: The Bills TE continues to battle a recurring left knee injury stemming from a torn PCL suffered three seasons ago, causing him to miss five games in 2025. The Bills plan to manage his practice load with ongoing load management strategies.

players.name: Eli Stowers
players.blurb: The Eagles' second-round tight end pick from Vanderbilt is a converted quarterback with elite athleticism but is still learning the position. Stowers is expected to be at full health when training camp opens and is considered a roster lock alongside Dallas Goedert.

players.name: Jayden Higgins
players.blurb: Higgins has secured the clear-cut No. 2 wide receiver role for the Houston Texans, with head coach DeMeco Ryans praising his physical maturation and improved top-end speed during camp.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.blurb: The Cleveland Browns drafted Boston in the second round as part of an upgrade to a receiving corps that ranked last in 2025 in both receiving yards and touchdown catches.

players.name: RJ Harvey
players.blurb: Harvey showed flashes of potential in his rookie season, scoring 16-plus fantasy points in six of his final 10 games, but faces a committee situation in Denver alongside Dobbins and first-rounder Jonah Coleman.

players.name: Daniel Jones
players.blurb: The Colts QB is expected to be ready for training camp after recovering from December Achilles surgery, having progressed through individual work and seven-on-seven drills in OTAs. Jones is set to start for Indianapolis.

players.name: Bryce Young
players.blurb: The Panthers QB enters his fourth season with the biggest storyline being whether he can play himself into a new long-term contract. Young is being asked to lead Carolina toward a first winning season since 2017.

players.name: Chuba Hubbard
players.blurb: Signed four-year, $33.2 million extension with Carolina Panthers, keeping him through 2028 as the team's featured back.

players.name: Travis Kelce
players.blurb: The 37-year-old Chiefs TE signed a new multi-year contract and finished TE3 in fantasy scoring last season with 76 catches for 851 yards and five touchdowns. His efficiency has declined (6.9 yards per target over two seasons vs. career 8.6), making him a lower-end TE1 projection.

players.name: Oronde Gadsden II
players.blurb: Gadsden returns after a promising 2025 rookie season with 49 catches for 664 yards and three touchdowns, but will face tighter end-zone opportunities with the Chargers' additions of Charlie Kolar and David Njoku.

players.name: Stefon Diggs
players.blurb: Released by New England Patriots March 11 heading into 2026; exploring options with Commanders and multiple other teams after proving at age 32 he still has production left post-ACL.

players.name: Ty Simpson
players.blurb: The Rams' 13th overall pick agreed to a four-year, $25.4 million fully guaranteed rookie deal and is competing with Stetson Bennett to back up Matthew Stafford. Simpson may see starter reps as Stafford misses select practices to manage workload.

players.name: Kenny Gainwell
players.blurb: Gainwell signed a two-year, $14 million deal with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers in March and is thriving as the team's lead running back heading into training camp.

players.name: Xavier Worthy
players.blurb: The Kansas City Chiefs third-year receiver faces pressure to produce after losing both Hollywood Brown and JuJu Smith-Schuster in free agency, presenting an expanded opportunity in camp.

players.name: George Kittle
players.blurb: Kittle was placed on the physically unable to perform list at the start of 49ers camp due to an Achilles injury from January, but the team is optimistic he'll be ready for Week 1 against the Rams in Melbourne.

players.name: Jakobi Meyers
players.blurb: Meyers was traded from the Raiders to the Jacksonville Jaguars in November 2025 and quickly signed a three-year, $60 million extension through 2028. He will enter training camp preparing for his first full season with the Jaguars after arriving mid-year.

players.name: J.K. Dobbins
players.blurb: The Broncos RB led Denver with 772 rushing yards in 10 regular-season games in 2025 before a season-ending foot injury and is considered a priority for coach Sean Payton. Dobbins will navigate backfield competition from RJ Harvey and Jonah Coleman but should maintain his early-down role.

players.name: Blake Corum
players.blurb: The Rams RB looked explosive coming out of the backfield on Day 1 of training camp and head coach Sean McVay said he'd be surprised if Corum doesn't improve and positively impact the team. Kyren Williams is listed as the starter with Corum in a backup role.

players.name: Jayden Reed
players.blurb: The Packers WR missed 2½ months of the 2025 season with a shoulder injury but Green Bay rewarded him with a three-year, $50.25 million contract extension this offseason. Reed is expected to lead the Packers receiving corps alongside Christian Watson.

players.name: Rachaad White
players.blurb: Washington signed veteran running back Rachaad White in free agency, where he'll compete for touches and bring his pass-catching ability—he has caught 50-plus passes in three of his four NFL seasons.

players.name: Matthew Golden
players.blurb: The Green Bay Packers' second-year wide receiver is slated to take on a significantly greater role in the offense and is expected to emerge as a starter opposite Watson in 2026.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.blurb: The Chicago Bears RB totaled 783 rushing yards and 164 receiving yards in 2025 and enters his second season expected to provide continued complement to D'Andre Swift. Monangai should maintain a significant backfield role in 2026.

players.name: Aaron Jones Sr.
players.blurb: Aaron Jones agreed to a restructured contract to remain with the Minnesota Vikings for 2026 and will reclaim a key role in their backfield alongside Jordan Mason.

players.name: Brenton Strange
players.blurb: Strange had the best year of his career in 2025 despite missing five games to injury and enters 2026 fully healthy with elevated expectations from the Jacksonville Jaguars.

players.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
players.blurb: Rookie running back Croskey-Merritt ranked eighth in percentage of runs gaining 10-plus yards as a rookie and brings explosiveness to the Commanders' 2026 backfield training camp battle.

players.name: Ricky Pearsall
players.blurb: The 49ers WR has missed 14 games over his first two NFL seasons but is expected to take on a much larger role in 2026 opposite veteran newcomer Mike Evans. Pearsall recorded 36 catches for 528 yards in limited action last season and is determined to prove himself a valuable weapon.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.blurb: Free agent WR waiting for training camp injury opportunity to sign; stated he still has "at least three, four good years left" in response to potential 49ers return speculation.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.blurb: Mason was traded from the San Francisco 49ers to the Minnesota Vikings in March 2025 and is expected to reclaim a key role in Minnesota's backfield alongside Aaron Jones.

players.name: Jalen Coker
players.blurb: Undrafted free agent turned star for Carolina Panthers who agreed to three-year extension through 2029; enters camp as established starting receiver alongside Tetairoa McMillan.

players.name: Romeo Doubs
players.blurb: Doubs hit the turf multiple times at his first Patriots practice but dismissed concerns, attributing the issues to adjusting to new field conditions while working alongside Pro Bowl receiver A.J. Brown.

players.name: Dallas Goedert
players.blurb: Philadelphia Eagles' TE1 delivered career-high 60 receptions for 591 yards and set Eagles tight end TD record with 11 in 2025, entering camp as clear lead option.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.blurb: Seahawks running back Charbonnet was officially placed on the physically unable to perform list and will miss a minimum of four games while recovering from an ACL tear.

players.name: Khalil Shakir
players.blurb: Khalil Shakir is competing among the Buffalo Bills' wide receivers at training camp alongside DJ Moore and other receivers.

players.name: Travis Hunter
players.blurb: The Jacksonville Jaguars' rookie cornerback is six months post-surgery from an LCL tear and fully cleared for camp, though there's debate about maintaining his two-way usage between defense and offense.

players.name: Juwan Johnson
players.blurb: New Orleans Saints tight end had career-high 77 receptions for 889 yards and 3 TDs on 102 targets in 2025; profiles as safe PPR option despite limited upside entering age-30 season.

players.name: Mark Andrews
players.blurb: Baltimore Ravens tight end ranked in Tier 1 alongside Kelce and Kittle despite TD-dependent profile; benefits from lost target competition this offseason.

players.name: Antonio Williams
players.blurb: Third-round WR selection by Washington Commanders in 2026 draft, arriving for first NFL training camp as franchise builds offensive core.

players.name: Jonah Coleman
players.blurb: Fourth-round running back drafted by Denver Broncos in 2026; had strong college season at Nebraska with 758 rushing yards and 15 TDs in 12 games.

players.name: Michael Penix Jr.
